checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: resumed block-boundary snapshot must credit Momentum once

impact_assessment.why: Reloading at block_complete re-added the same block's outcome, doubling displayed momentum and the amount banked (browser: 100 saved -> 200 shown; test: 36 vs 18)
impact_assessment.benefits: Resume preserves the exact pre-reload reward; banked total stays honest across reloads
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot format and UI unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none beyond existing useEffect save interval; state: only the in-memory credited-block guard changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first App regression plus fixed-clock browser playthrough; full test/typecheck/build/ai:verify gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Fix: seed credited-block ref from the restored snapshot when its motivation already has this block's outcome; failing-first App test and scripts/resume-proof.mjs added; before 200 vs after 100 on the same seed/state

[3/3] Verified: before/after screenshots same 390x844@2x viewport and seed 2721744568; before Unbanked 200 / after 100, banked 100; 29 Python + 248 Vitest, ai:verify 400/400, typecheck clean, aikit check 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'noesis-cycle1-resume-momentum' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: evidence citations must be single 44px+ tappable PubMed rows with the PMID in the accessible name

impact_assessment.why: 390x844 audit measured 13 citation links at 21px high, below the project's own 44px floor (ADR-030/R33), with PMIDs outside the link and no row boundary
impact_assessment.benefits: Older-adult touch targets, clearer source rows, PMID exposed in the link name and focus target
impact_assessment.risks: contract: evidence copy, hrefs and routes unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no storage change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first structure test, fixed-clock browser audit with before/after screenshots and popup check, full gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Fix: CitationLink wraps label + PMID in one anchor; .citations rows min-height 48px; PMID 0.8rem; failing-first test and scripts/ui-audit.mjs added; audit 21px/5 small targets -> 59px/0

[3/3] Verified: before/after 390x844@2x evidence screenshots same seed/state; minHeight 21->59, 5->0 small targets, popup URL same; 29 Python + 249 Vitest, ai:verify 400/400, typecheck clean, aikit check 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'noesis-cycle2-evidence-citations' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: feedback frames must keep the just-shown trial stimulus and mark the stage with its tone

impact_assessment.why: Feedback appeared over an empty stage; scripted capture showed stimulus null and stageFeedback null in both N-back and Go/No-Go
impact_assessment.benefits: Result is visibly attached to the trial it belongs to; redundant non-colour signal
impact_assessment.risks: contract: scoring, timing and copy unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: view payload gains feedback-phase stimulus but session state shape is unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first engine and stage tests, fixed-clock browser feedback harness with before/after frames, full gates

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Fix: N-back/Go-No-Go/Speed views expose stimulus in feedback; MechanicStage data-feedback on all four stages; CSS dims stimulus and tints border; failing-first tests and scripts/feedback-proof.mjs added

[3/3] Verified: 390x844@2x before/after N-back and Go/No-Go feedback frames same seed; before stimulus null both, after D/correct and square/incorrect; 29 Python + 249 Vitest, ai:verify 400/400, typecheck clean, aikit check 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'noesis-cycle3-feedback-visibility' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: Go/No-Go prompt must be trial-independent after the shape disappears

impact_assessment.why: The blank response window named the current trial (go: Respond to the circle; no-go: Do not respond to the square), letting a late response read the answer
impact_assessment.benefits: Response inhibition is measured from the shape, not the prompt; no information leak after stimulus offset
impact_assessment.risks: contract: prompt copy changes but timing, window, scoring and input unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first prompt-equality test, fixed-seed browser response-window playthrough with before/after frames and a late commission, full gates

[1/3] Plan: quick sessions must rotate the two-mechanic window so repeated short sessions cover all four tasks

impact_assessment.why: Quick sessions always took nback+gonogo; four fixed-clock runs recorded one pair and only 2/4 mechanics
impact_assessment.benefits: Reasoning and Speed Tap become reachable without changing the five-minute length; seed determinism retained
impact_assessment.risks: contract: quick lineup changes, standard/focus unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no storage change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first rotation test, fixed-clock four-session browser playthrough including one completed quick session, README update, full gates
